_comment: Assessment Generator. Endpoint flow: every screen is served by the server so what she sees is always valid for the book we actually hold. Screens: CLASS -> COVERAGE (-> PAGES) -> QUESTIONS (-> TYPES) -> CONFIRM -> SUBMITTED.
_instructions: Publish via scripts/setup/register-all-flows.js. The endpoint is /api/flows/assessment-gen.
